ServiceActionEndpoint.description: Triggers a lifecycle action (start, stop, restart, install, build, pull, setup, update) on a service

AppliedServiceFile.description: Per-file outcome of an apply operation. `unresolved` lists every distinct `{{NAME}}` placeholder that remained in the written content because no matching key was present in the resolved environment variables. The file is still written verbatim; the list lets callers warn the user about the missing variables instead of silently leaving placeholders behind.

ApplyServiceFilesEndpoint.description: Writes shared and local service files to disk, optionally for a single file

ServiceLogsEndpoint.description: Retrieves recent log entries for a service, optionally filtered by process UID or search text

ClearServiceLogsEndpoint.description: Deletes all stored log entries for a service

ServiceHistoryEndpoint.description: Retrieves the state transition history for a service

previousState.description: JSON snapshot of relevant status fields before the change

newState.description: JSON snapshot of relevant status fields after the change

triggeredBy.description: Username of the user who triggered the action, or 'system'

metadata.description: Optional JSON with extra context (exit code, error message, etc.)

processUid.description: UUID of the associated process, if this event produced log output

ServiceStateHistory.description: Audit log entry for service state transitions. Records every lifecycle event (start, stop, crash, install, build, pull) with full context: who triggered it, how, and any relevant metadata. Entries are never deleted and not included in exports.

ServiceStateEvent.description: Event types for service state transitions. Each value represents a discrete lifecycle event that can occur.

TriggerSource.description: How a state change was triggered. Used to distinguish user actions from automated system behavior.

ServiceBranchesEndpoint.description: Lists local and remote branches for the service's linked repository

ServiceCheckoutEndpoint.description: Switches the service's repository to a different branch

ServiceDeleteBranchEndpoint.description: Deletes a local branch in the service's repository, optionally switching to a target branch first

ServiceDismissWarningEndpoint.description: Dismisses an inline warning for a service (in-memory, resets on service restart)
